words.enExample: Reading before bed is a habit I picked up years ago.
words.zhExample: 睡前阅读是我多年前养成的一个习惯。
words.note: 源自拉丁语 habitus（状态、习惯）。常见搭配 form / build / develop a habit（养成习惯），break a habit（改掉习惯）。近义：custom / routine；区别：habit 偏个人日常，custom 偏群体传统。

words.enExample: Small, consistent effort beats occasional bursts of ambition.
words.zhExample: 微小而持久的努力，胜过偶尔的雄心爆发。
words.note: con-（共同）+ sist（站立）+ -ent → 稳稳站在一起、不摇摆。反义：inconsistent。副词 consistently 很常用：He shows up consistently.（他始终如一地出现。）

words.meaning: 使复利增长；使累积加重
words.enExample: Small wins compound into remarkable results over time.
words.zhExample: 小小的胜利随时间复利式累积，终成惊人的结果。
words.note: 作动词读 /kəmˈpaʊnd/，作名词“化合物”同形。金融里 compound interest = 复利；此处用其比喻义“累积放大”。近义：accumulate / multiply。

words.enExample: A calm morning routine sets the tone for the whole day.
words.zhExample: 一个平静的晨间例行程序，定下整天的基调。
words.note: 来自 route（路线）。daily routine 指“日常安排”。routine 也可作形容词：a routine task（常规任务）。近义：habit / schedule。

words.enExample: Daily reading can transform the way you think.
words.zhExample: 每日阅读能改变你的思维方式。
words.note: trans-（跨越）+ form（形状）→ 改变形态。名词 transformation。强调由内而外的根本变化，比 change 更彻底。近义：change / convert。

essay.title: The Quiet Power of Habits
essay.author: 佚名
paragraphs: Habits are the invisible architecture of our days. We rarely notice them, yet they quietly decide far more of our lives than the occasional bold decision ever will.

The good news is that habits compound. A small action repeated daily—reading ten pages, walking after lunch, writing one honest line—seems trivial in a single day, but over a year it quietly turns you into a different person.

So do not wait for motivation to arrive. Build the tiny system, show up for it imperfectly, and let consistency do the heavy lifting. The life you want is mostly a collection of ordinary days, lived with care.
translations: 习惯是我们日子的隐形架构。我们很少留意它们，但它们静悄悄地决定了我们生活的绝大部分——远胜于偶尔那几个大胆的决定。
好消息是，习惯会复利式增长。每天重复的一个小动作——读十页书、饭后走一走、写一句真诚的话——在一天里看似微不足道，但一年之后，它会把你静悄悄地变成另一个人。
所以，别等动力自己找上门。搭好那个微小的系统，哪怕完成得不够完美也坚持去做，把重担交给"坚持"。你想要的生活，多半只是一连串被好好度过的平凡日子。

grammar.example: "We rarely notice them, yet they quietly decide far more of our lives than the occasional bold decision ever will."
"A small action repeated daily—reading ten pages, walking after lunch, writing one honest line—seems trivial in a single day..."

vocab.enExample: Habits are the invisible architecture of our days.
vocab.zhExample: 习惯是我们每一天的隐形架构。
vocab.note: 原指建筑学，引申为「底层结构」。原文用 invisible architecture 比喻习惯暗中支撑生活。近义 structure / framework；反义 chaos。

vocab.enExample: The good news is that habits compound.
vocab.zhExample: 好消息是：习惯会产生复利效应。
vocab.note: 名词 compound interest 即「复利」，动词化后指效果越滚越大。写作中比 accumulate 更强调指数式增长。反义 diminish。

vocab.enExample: A small action repeated daily seems trivial in a single day.
vocab.zhExample: 每天重复的小事，单看一天似乎微不足道。
vocab.note: 侧重「不值一提」，语气比 small 更强。搭配 trivial matter / seem trivial。近义 insignificant；反义 significant / crucial。

vocab.enExample: Let consistency do the heavy lifting.
vocab.zhExample: 让「持续」去承担最吃力的那部分。
vocab.note: 形容词 consistent（始终如一的）。自我提升类文章高频词：consistency beats intensity（持续胜过强度）。近义 regularity；反义 inconsistency。

vocab.meaning: 承担最繁重/最吃力的部分
vocab.enExample: Build the tiny system and let consistency do the heavy lifting.
vocab.zhExample: 搭好那个小系统，然后让持续去做最吃力的活。
vocab.note: 口语习语，heavy lifting 本义「搬重物」。常用于「让机制替你出力」。近义 shoulder the burden；反义 coast along。

vocab.enExample: Do not wait for motivation to arrive.
vocab.zhExample: 别等着动力自己来敲门。
vocab.note: motivation 偏外部诱因，drive 偏内在冲劲。反义 procrastination（拖延）。相关词 motivate（激励）、motive（动机）。

vocab.enExample: Show up for it imperfectly, and let consistency do the heavy lifting.
vocab.zhExample: 不完美地坚持到场，然后让持续替你出力。
vocab.note: 比 attend 更口语，含「不缺席、肯扛着」的态度。名言：80% of success is showing up。近义 turn up；反义 bail out。

vocab.enExample: Build the tiny system and show up for it imperfectly.
vocab.zhExample: 搭好小系统，然后不完美地坚持去做。
vocab.note: im-（否定）+ perfectly。原文劝人别等准备好才开始。近义 roughly / messily；反义 flawlessly / perfectly。
